script_text: Stop, Virgo — Mercury is about to change everything for you right now. Mercury, your ruling planet, is forming a powerful conjunction with Venus at 28° Virgo in your 1st House of Self, and your Earth element grounds this energy into real, tangible shifts. Meanwhile, Saturn in Aries from your 8th House of Hidden Matters is squaring that same Mercury, creating pressure around secrets, private finances, and buried truths that need releasing. In love, this Venus-Mercury conjunction is deeply magnetic — if single, someone unexpected could enter your world. If taken, prepare for a raw conversation about something you've both been avoiding. Career-wise, Uranus in Gemini activating your 10th House of Public Standing is delivering a sudden professional opportunity — it could arrive before the week ends. Don't hide from what Saturn is revealing; face it, because it's your greatest blessing. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
